scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exact finite two-layer collision variance for every binary directed regular adjacency matrix, 2<=r<=d-2, and design rigidity; no large-n limit.

title: Four-cycle variance and design rigidity in two-layer permuted graph occupancy
